rows.text: The Assembly's news item created on 16 December 2025 reports that 'During the same Special Sitting, presided over by Interim Speaker Lord Tangi, Parliament elected Tongatapu No. 2 Noble Representative Lord Vaea as Speaker of Parliament, and Ha'apai No. 2 Noble Representative Lord Tu'iha'angana as Deputy Speaker', and that Lord Vaea thanked Members after his election.
rows.uncertainty: The Assembly's election of its Speaker, recorded separately from the royal appointment effective 18 December 2025 (to_speakers_appointment; to_speaker_vaea_royal_appointment_to_20251218) and from the oath (to_speaker_vaea_oath_news_20260122). The item does not print the day of the Special Sitting; the Interim Speaker's notice of 12 December scheduled the meeting for Monday 15 December 2025 (to_speaker_election_meeting_notice_20251212). The claim is attested on the item's date and no sitting day is inferred.

rows.text: The same item states that the Special Sitting at which the Prime Minister-Designate, the Speaker and the Deputy Speaker were elected was 'presided over by Interim Speaker Lord Tangi', and it describes Lord Fakafanua as 'Former Speaker of the Legislative Assembly'.
rows.uncertainty: Interim service is a claim only, never a holder. 'Former Speaker' describes Lord Fakafanua on 16 December 2025; it is not used as an end date for his Speakership, which no retrieved source states.
